audit.why: Tricky 7.5/10 with a 9.5/10 carry threat matches the shape: Poppy owns level 1-5 on stats and wall windows, Gangplank owns the game from first item onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with both the packet chart AND the already-audited mirror, and it also contradicted its own whys: win[0] said 'Gangplank' while whys[0] said Poppy out-stats him at 1; win[2]/win[3] said 'Poppy' while whys[2]/whys[3] said 'genuinely even' and 'skill decides it'; win[4] said 'Gangplank' while whys[4] said 'the lane stays even'.
audit.why: Mirror point 3 fixed the whole chart as one group: L1 Poppy, L2 Skill, L3 Skill, L4-5 Skill, L6 Skill, First item Gangplank, 2+ items Gangplank. The packet levelChart is identical. The whys already described exactly that chart — only the side tokens were wrong.
audit.corrected: All seven rows flipped as one atomic group in both layers, with ratings inverted from the mirror's (3/10 -> 7/10 at L1, 7/10 -> 3/10 at first item, 8/10 -> 2/10 at 2+ items).

audit.whatIsWrong: Two factual errors. (a) The page repeatedly said Remove Scurvy cleanses only the slows and that 'the wall slam is the part that sticks'. (b) tradeGood told the player to 'W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion'; Gangplank has no dash at all.
audit.why: Riot's text for Remove Scurvy is 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health' — that cures the Heroic Charge stun itself, which inverts the advice. Gangplank's kit carries no dash flag anywhere.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy is now named with its 22/20/18/16/14s cooldown and correctly described as curing the stun; the dash line is replaced with baiting that cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance, and the don'ts implied armour stacking answers him.
audit.why: _missing flags both: Remove Scurvy sustain means Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades, and Cannon Barrage deals true damage so resistances are the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: Added to wants.you[1], dontsFull[1].d and spikes[3].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block named 'Powder Kegs' as the matchup-defining cooldown. Powder Keg has a 0s ability cooldown (charge-based placement) — it is not the timer to track.
audit.why: The real punish window is Remove Scurvy at 22s rank 1, plus Parrrley chip at 4.5s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around Remove Scurvy and Parrrley.

edits.before: E Gangplank into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E Gangplank into a wall the moment a barrel is popped, Q the zone under him, and burst him out before Remove Scurvy (22s) is back.

edits.before: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Powder Keg is free to place — kill it early; his gold and poke die with it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage does true damage — armour stacking will not save you.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Remove Scurvy (22/20/18/16/14s): cures your E stun outright and heals — this is the cooldown to bait, not the kegs. - Parrrley (4.5s): constant chip. - Keeper's Verdict: a kill or a saved life only.

edits.before: My level-2 Q+E into a wall is a real stun if he hugs terrain for barrels, but his W can cleanse the slow — so it's a coin-flip, skill window.
edits.after: My level-2 Q+E into a wall is a real stun if he hugs terrain for kegs, but Remove Scurvy cures the stun itself — so it's a skill window.

edits.before: At level 1 I actually out-stat Gangplank — W's passive gives me armor and MR while he has paper-thin bases, and my Q chunks his max HP regardless of gold. Don't chase him off barrels; instead walk up under W and last-hit, eating a little barrel poke because his early damage can't out-tempo my health bar yet. From level 2 my Q+E is a real wall-stun: if he stands near terrain to detonate a barrel chain, E him into the wall and Q the chunk before he reacts. Just respect that his W cleanses my E-slow and Q-slow, so the wall slam is the part that sticks — the slows aren't.
edits.after: At level 1 I actually out-stat Gangplank — W's passive gives me armor and MR while he has paper-thin bases, and my Q chunks his max HP regardless of gold. Don't chase him off kegs; walk up under W and last-hit, eating a little Parrrley chip because his early damage can't out-tempo my health bar yet. From level 2 my Q+E is a real wall-stun: if he stands near terrain to detonate a keg chain, E him into the wall and Q the chunk before he reacts. Respect that Remove Scurvy (22s at rank 1) cures the stun itself, not just my slows — bait it out first and the wall slam actually sticks.

edits.before: Catch a barrel misplay and E him into a wall for the stun, then Q the max-HP chunk before he W-cleanses
edits.after: Bait Remove Scurvy first, then E him into a wall and Q the max-HP chunk while it sits on 22 seconds

edits.before: Use W's passive armor/MR to walk up and last-hit through his early barrel poke
edits.after: Buy Grievous Wounds early — Remove Scurvy's heal is what saves his trades

edits.before: Hold W to cleanse your E-stun slow and your Q slow, then walk away from your wall
edits.after: Hold Remove Scurvy to cure your E wall-stun outright, then stroll out of range

edits.before: Gangplank's spike: Sheen/Essence Reaver crit barrels and W cleanse make his trades free, and his global R takes over the map while you flatten out.
edits.after: His spike: Sheen crit kegs and Remove Scurvy make trades free, and Cannon Barrage's true damage ignores every point of armour you stacked.
